mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate lower borrowing costs and increased liquidity.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months, it signals persistent labor market weakness that prompts central bank rate cuts, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as investors price in monetary stimulus.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.5% for two months, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction permits (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a sharp contraction in consumer demand, triggering a flight to quality that depresses S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as recession fears intensify.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions characterized by robust industrial production (INDPRO > 115), supply chain bottlenecks ease, boosting corporate profits and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate sustained growth.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO exceeds 115, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption (measured by RSAFS) over the past 6 months signals strong consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as corporate earnings growth accelerates.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS increases for 6 consecutive months, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When the core inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 2.5% for three consecutive months, it signals persistent inflation that triggers central bank hawkishness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as bond yields rise and equity valuations contract.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5% for three months, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and declines in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicate a deteriorating labor market, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as recession risks rise and investors seek safe havens.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions with strong housing starts (HOUST > 1800), demand for consumer goods accelerates, boosting corporate revenues and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the economy approaches its peak.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST exceeds 1800, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.
